model_observation.scope: Actual omitted model overrides mean inherited session defaults; explicit experimental requests, where present, remain requests. The host does not expose authenticated resolved backend identities.

metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: Shared host, instruction-only isolation, a failed child dispatch and explicit path recovery limit controlled-comparison inference. Narrow tables require horizontal navigation and keyboard semantics were not verified. No natural-time playback, full accessibility audit, hardware phone/IME, other engines, fault-injected network recovery or user preference study. Native role binding, resolved models, tokens and cost remain unavailable. Independent acceptance is separate.
